text:
maria: Ran the staging soak overnight against per-key + per-org quotas. Observations: quota UI says 300r/s per-org with 500 burst, but enforcement dropped to ~200r/s after sustained traffic and a hard 60s cooldown kicked in. Strange spike in 429s around 02:10 UTC.

aj: thanks for the run notes — do you have the raw harness command? was this k6 or vegeta?

maria: used k6 script (lightweight):
```
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 60m /tests/staging/quota_soak.js --out json=run.json
```
payload was a mix of auth keys (50% per-org scopes, 50% per-key) to exercise both codepaths.

chen: can you paste the quota config you tested against? are these the new per-team overrides?

maria: config snippet we applied to staging (via console rollout):
```
{
  "org_default": {"rps": 300, "burst": 500},
  "per_key_override": {"key_xyz": {"rps": 1000, "burst": 100}},
  "burst_window_sec": 60
}
```

ops-bot: [test-run-summary] run_id=stg-soak-2026-03-17-08, total_requests=18,720,000, 429_count=4,320 (23.1%), avg_latency_p50=120ms, peak_cpu_proxy=86%

aj: 23% 429s is high. Two quick suspects: 1) token-bucket refill math applied per-proxy-shard not aggregated, 2) our proxy backpressure queue length triggers a cooldown that wasn't accounted for in console. I can pull traces.

kevin: I noticed the console's quota graph shows "effective rps" computed from counters that exclude queued requests. That will make the UI optimistic vs enforcement. We should surface both "accepted" and "rejected+queued" curves.

chen: we have a small bug in token_bucket.go where max_burst is clipped by per-shard capacity on refill. If a key is routed to a busy shard it can't borrow from others — intended for isolation but bugs the burst_window aggregation. I'll open a PR.

maria: repro timeline: steady 320r/s for 10m, then 400r/s for 5m (burst), then 60s later enforcement fell to ~200r/s until ~+8m. The 60s maps to our burst_window_sec. Feels like the per-shard bucket depleted and didn't replenish globally.

aj: adding APM traces: https://apm.redwood.internal/trace/stg/84a7d3 — shows queuing at frontend-proxy instance-7 and heavy GC around 02:09:50. Also saw a spike in backend retries.

kevin: action item: add a "quota_projection" metric that predicts remaining burst capacity per-org (approx). Would help the console warn before 429 spike.

sarah: for validation, let's add a short smoke test to the CI that runs a 5m burst and asserts no more than X% 429s and that per-key overrides behave (i.e., keys with per_key_override don't get penalized by org-level depletion). Also add tags in harness so we can attribute 429s to "queue" vs "token_reject".

chen: PR incoming for token_bucket fix. I will also add a metric "bucket_shard_utilization" to expose imbalance.

maria: I'll rerun the soak with a modified router that uses cross-shard borrowing (experimental flag) + enhanced metrics. Run scheduled for 03:30 UTC.

aj: I'll prepare a short runbook snippet for on-call: how to diagnose quota-induced 429 flaps (APM link, metrics to check, quick mitigation: lower traffic or enable fallback config).

kevin: UX follow-up: console should display the applied enforcement layer (org vs key vs override) when you hover over the quota chart. Helps avoid confusion when numbers differ.

ops-bot: [scheduled-job] stg-soak-rerun scheduled at 1743606600 (03:30 UTC) by maria

maria: thanks all. Please react to confirm ownership: chen -> fix + metric, aj -> runbook + traces, kevin -> dashboard change, sarah -> CI smoke test, i'll re-run and post results. :thumbsup:

chen: ack

aj: ack

kevin: ack

sarah: ack
